column1: # Every line in non-test crates/trawl-server/src code that builds a String or an
# error from an error with {e}, {err} or {error}, and where that text ends up.
# These are sources, not log events: `enumerate.py --hits` lists them.
#   IO-ONLY     std::io::Error text that reaches an INFO-or-above retained event (the D2b rows, issue #413)
#   REDACTED    reaches an INFO-or-above event only as error_class and cause_kind or fixed words; the text is at DEBUG
#   NOT-LOGGED  reaches no tracing event (stderr at boot, an HTTP response, a stored row, or dropped)
#   DEBUG-ONLY  reaches tracing at DEBUG or TRACE only
# This is a record made by reading the code once. No script regenerates it.
